title: Region based spatial transcriptomics analysis with scider
text: scider user-friendly R package providing functions model global density cells slide spatial transcriptomics data. functions package built SpatialExperiment object, allowing integration various spatial transcriptomics-related packages Bioconductor. modelling density, scider supports several downstream analyses, including colocalization analysis, boundary detection differential density analysis. plotting functions return ggplot objects, figures can customised ggplot2 layer. vignette walks typical workflow Xenium breast cancer dataset.

title: Region based spatial transcriptomics analysis with scider
text: scider implements grid-based density analysis spatial transcriptomics data. first calculate density cell type using function gridDensity. calculated density grid information saved metadata SpatialExperiment object. size grid (bin) set grid.length.x parameter, level smoothing set bandwidth. can visualise overall (cell types) density whole tissue using function plotDensity. probs parameter indicates density percentile grids filtered (plotted). Setting probs 0 plot everything including background.  Alternatively, user can specify cutoff filter grids low cell density. density values represent expected numbers cells grid.  can also visualise density specific cell type(s).
code: spe <- gridDensity(spe, grid.length.x = 50, bandwidth = 50) plotDensity(spe, probs = 0) plotDensity(spe, cutoff = 5) plotDensity(spe, coi = COI)

title: Region based spatial transcriptomics analysis with scider
text: obtaining grid-based density cell type, can detect regions--interest (ROIs) based density certain cell type(s). done using findROI function. identify ROIs based cell density DCIS invasive tumor. min.density parameter filters grids low cell density, whereas ngrid.min gives minimum number grids ROI . ROIs can visualized using plotROI.
code: spe <- findROI(spe, coi = COI, min.density = 0.5, ngrid.min = 20) #> Overwriting the probs argument. Grids are filtered by the min.density value. plotROI(spe, roi = COI)
